text: Tell me about your hometown. What do you like most about it?
How do you usually spend your weekends?
Do you prefer reading books or watching films? Why?
What kind of music do you enjoy listening to, and when do you listen to it?
Do you enjoy spending time outdoors? Why or why not?
How important is learning English for your future plans?
Tell me about a hobby you have. How did you become interested in it?
What is your favourite type of food, and why do you like it?
Do you like travelling? Where would you like to go next, and why?
How often do you use social media, and what do you use it for?
Tell me about a teacher who influenced you. What did you learn from them?
Do you usually prefer to study alone or with friends? Why?
What kind of weather do you enjoy most, and what do you like to do in it?
How important is exercise in your daily life?
Tell me about a family tradition that is important to you.
Do you think technology has changed the way young people communicate? In what way?
What kind of job would you like to have in the future, and why?
What is your typical day like?
Tell me about your first teacher. What do you remember about them?
Do you have any pets? If yes, tell me about them; if not, would you like to have one?
Tell me about your best friend. How did you meet?
Do you enjoy cooking? What is the last thing you cooked?
What do you usually do in your free time?
Tell me about a sport or game you enjoy playing or watching.
How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
Do you like shopping? Where do you prefer to shop, online or in stores?
Tell me about a place in your city that you would recommend to a visitor.
What kind of films or TV shows do you enjoy watching?
How important is your family in your daily life?
Do you enjoy taking photos? What do you usually take pictures of?
Tell me about a gift you received that was special to you.
What was the last book you read, and what did you think of it?
Do you prefer mornings or evenings? Why?
How do you usually get around your city — by bus, car, or on foot?
